headline: Almaty Final: Medvedev defeats Basilashvili in three sets for 25th career title
whyCareReason: Daniil Medvedev achieved the first title defense of his career, defeating Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7(6), 6-1, 6-3.
teaser: Medvedev d. Basilashvili 6-7(6), 6-1, 6-3 in 1h 53m. 25th career title and fourth trophy of the 2026 season.
story: Top seed Daniil Medvedev captured the Almaty Open title on Sunday, 25 October, mounting a resilient comeback to defeat Georgian qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7(6), 6-1, 6-3 in one hour and 53 minutes. The victory marked a historic career breakthrough for Medvedev: for the first time in his professional career, he successfully defended a tour-level singles title. Basilashvili, competing in his first ATP final in five years, played fearless tennis to snatch a tight opening tiebreak 8-6. Medvedev responded by raising his return depth and baseline consistency, dropping just four games across the final two sets to lift his 25th career ATP singles trophy.
stakes: Medvedev secures his fourth title of 2026 and celebrates his first-ever successful ATP title defense.
rivalryAngle: Basilashvili capped a dream week from qualifying while Medvedev proved his hardcourt mastery in Kazakhstan.
funFacts: Final: Daniil Medvedev d. Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7(6), 6-1, 6-3.
First time in Medvedev's 25 title wins that he successfully defended a crown.
Basilashvili reached the final as a qualifier after defeating Tsitsipas in the semifinals.
